rule: No tax on conversion itself (negative finding)
trigger: Buying USD with one's own lawful CNY and wiring it out
conditions: This is a negative finding from the official pages read; it is not a statement about tax on the underlying income or gain.

trigger: Underlying wages or comprehensive income
conditions: Progressive rates under IIT Law Art. 3; applies to income, not conversion.

trigger: Underlying business income
conditions: IIT Law Art. 3.

trigger: Interest, dividends, rent, property transfer, incidental income
conditions: IIT Law Art. 3; property transfer is taxed on gain after original value and reasonable expenses.

trigger: RMB savings-deposit interest

rule: Tax record-filing before large outbound payment
trigger: Single outbound payment >USD 50,000 for salary/dividends/real-estate income etc.
rate_or_amount: 税务备案表 required; no fixed percentage
conditions: STA/SAFE 2013 No. 40; property guide waives the form at ≤USD 50,000.

trigger: Tax not paid by the deadline
conditions: Tax Collection Administration Law Art. 32.

trigger: False books/returns causing underpaid tax
conditions: Tax Collection Administration Law Art. 63; criminal liability if a crime.

trigger: Moving FX abroad in violation, or by deception
rate_or_amount: Up to 30% of amount; 30%-100% if serious
conditions: Decree 532 Art. 39; repatriation order and criminal liability possible.

rule: False documents to buy FX (非法套汇)
trigger: False/invalid transaction documents
conditions: Decree 532 Art. 40; funds ordered converted back.

trigger: Carrying FX across the border in breach of rules
conditions: Decree 532 Art. 42; separate permit rules in BS22.

trigger: Private buying/selling, disguised forms, brokering
conditions: Decree 532 Art. 45; SAFE Guangdong warning.

trigger: Individual provides untrue documents or fails reporting
conditions: Decree 532 Art. 48.

trigger: Borrowing others' convenience amounts or evading authenticity review
rate_or_amount: Current year + 2 calendar years on 关注名单
conditions: 汇发〔2020〕14号 Art. 62; while listed, documents are required.

trigger: RMB 10,000/card/day or RMB 100,000/person/year exceeded
rate_or_amount: Overseas cash withdrawals suspended current + next year
conditions: 汇发〔2017〕29号; bank reports transactions under 汇发〔2017〕15号.

trigger: Carrying foreign banknotes out of China
rate_or_amount: ≤USD 5,000 release; USD 5,000-10,000 bank permit; >USD 10,000 SAFE permit in principle not granted
conditions: SAFE Hebei Q&A; Decree 532 Art. 42 penalty for breach.

trigger: Fiat↔virtual-currency exchange or unapproved stablecoin/RWA activity
rate_or_amount: Activity prohibited; no protective legal status
conditions: 银发〔2026〕42号 repeals 银发〔2021〕237号.

trigger: PRC-source dividend to U.S. beneficial owner
conditions: Treaty Art. 9(2); STA 2019 No. 35 self-assessment/report form and retained tax-residency/beneficial-owner documents.

trigger: PRC-source interest/royalty to U.S. beneficial owner
conditions: Treaty Arts. 10(2) and 11(2); saving clause preserves U.S. taxation of citizens.

trigger: Disposition of nonfunctional currency, including bank deposits
conditions: §988(e)(3) excludes §162/§212 expense transactions from personal treatment; exact basis unknown.

trigger: Aggregate foreign accounts >USD 10,000 at any time in the year
rate_or_amount: FinCEN Form 114; due Apr 15, auto-ext Oct 15
conditions: Electronic BSA e-filing; separate from Form 8938.

trigger: Non-willful FBAR violation
conditions: 31 U.S.C. §5321(a)(5)(B)(i) and 31 CFR 1010.821; reasonable-cause exception.

trigger: Willful FBAR violation
rate_or_amount: Greater of USD 100,000 (adjusted USD 165,353) or 50% of account balance
conditions: 31 U.S.C. §5321(a)(5)(C)-(D) plus eCFR adjusted table; Bittner-related IRM guidance is linked in BS46.

trigger: Specified foreign financial assets exceed filing thresholds
rate_or_amount: USD 10,000, +USD 10,000/30 days after notice, max USD 60,000
conditions: Single in U.S. USD 50,000 year-end / USD 75,000 any time; single abroad USD 200,000 / USD 300,000; joint double.

trigger: Gift/bequest from NRA/foreign estate >USD 100,000/year
rate_or_amount: Report on Form 3520 Part IV; late penalty 5%/month up to 25%
conditions: 26 U.S.C. §6039F has a reasonable-cause exception; corp/partnership gifts use the inflation-adjusted threshold.

rule: Foreign tax credit / treaty saving clause
trigger: PRC income tax paid on income also taxed by the U.S.
conditions: Treaty Art. 22(2); Protocol 1 ¶2 preserves U.S. taxation of its citizens.

trigger: Past non-willful noncompliance
rate_or_amount: SFOP: no streamlined penalty; SDOP: 5% miscellaneous offshore penalty
conditions: SFOP non-residency test, 3 years returns and 6 years FBARs; SDOP has its own eligibility and certification.

trigger: Foreign earned income from personal services
conditions: FEIE does not apply to existing savings, pension/annuity or currency gain; 2026 inflation-adjusted figure is deliberately blank.

trigger: Physically carrying/shipping >USD 10,000 into/out of the U.S.
conditions: Threshold applies collectively to a family/group; failure risks seizure/forfeiture and civil/criminal penalties.

trigger: Wire routed through one or more intermediary banks
conditions: BOC says each intermediary may deduct a transfer fee; no official single figure. OUR historical surcharge is USD 15/25 but current applicability is unverified.
